items.title: CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI
items.summary: In this Executive Function series from OpenAI, discover how CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI. Editor-in-Chief Walter Fernandez shares insights on AI adoption, culture, and the future of journalism.

items.title: SchoolAI builds an AI platform that empowers teachers
items.summary: SchoolAI uses GPT-4.1, image generation, and TTS to power safe, teacher-guided AI tools for over 1 million classrooms, improving engagement, oversight, and personalized learning.

items.title: OpenAI and NVIDIA announce strategic partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems
items.summary: OpenAI and NVIDIA announce a strategic partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of AI datacenters powered by NVIDIA systems, with the first phase launching in 2026.
